content: Yeypp guye, shaara ma77eeza hara mino kiitanchchay salopp sa7a wodhdhodar ta be7eeza. E ommayil afa zuulla yeza. E sinay awa garkke; e tokitay tama tuusitay garkke.
Ye kiitanchchay dooya yez pettii xiqqa xaath maxafitto fa kusher aykkii, fa ushachcha toke abbal afa, fa haddirssa toka biittal afa esseeza.
Xaagiza gaammo garkk fa qaala dhoqq udii uukkeeza. E ukkeez wode laappun daditay fa guumitha sisseeza.
Laappun daditay odintteez wode ta xaafodayis giigintteeza. Zini salopp, «Laappun daditay odintteezana maatamer gorddobap attin xaafippe» yeegiz giirthii ta si7eeza.
Yeypp guye abbal afannee biittal afa eqqii, ta be7eez kiitanchchay, fa ushachcha kushe salo udee miicceeza.
E miccii salonnee salo yez ubba, sa7annee sa7all yez ubba, abbannee e gancce yez ubba medhdheez medhinas yez Xoossay sunthayir caaqqii, «Yhaypp guye, gam7enna!
Zini laappuntha kiitanchchay fa tulitula sisiza wode Xoossii fa aylle maaqqeez nabitay baggar qoncciseez xuura qofay polinttoda» yeegeeza.
Yeypp guye, «Abbal afannee biittal afa eqqeezay kiitanchchay kushe dooyinttii yez xaath maxafitto ekkoba» yeegii nam7intho salopp taas ododar ta si7eeza.
Taanii ye kiitanchchayko yhanigii, xiqqa xaath maxafitto inggoba gi oyiceeza. E taako, «Ekkii izo mooba; iza ne ulayid canggoda, zin ne doonayid ees garkk mal7oda» yeegeeza.
Taanii kiitanchchay kushepp ye xiqqa xaath maxafitto ekkii meeza; ta doonayid eess garkk mal7eeza, zin ta meezaypp guye ta ulayid canggeeza.
Yeypp guye, taako, «Neenii gaame kochitayis, woyas, duma duma doonar odinttizitayisinnee kaatitayis tinbbite mahii ododayis beeziza» yeegeeza.
